plan_rules: Create one header .h file per class/interface/enum with a matching .c implementation file for classes, all named after the type in snake_case, and a shared header per diagram for cross-type includes.
style_rules: C rules: - Target C11 with standard library only; - a struct is used per class (typedef struct Name Name), interfaces as header-declared function-pointer structs or headers, enums as typedef enum; - no visibility keywords exist so use static for private functions in .c and declare public functions in .h; - attributes become struct fields with explicit types; - accessors are public getter/setter functions in the header; - inheritance is emulated by embedding the base struct as the first member (base name field) with upcasting via pointer casts; - interface realisation is emulated by function-pointer tables or simple function groups in headers; - relations become pointers, and any cardinality with maximum above 1 becomes a dynamically allocated array plus count fields; - include required headers with #include guards in every header; - never use system calls, sockets, file deletion, or environment access such as system, exec, fork, socket, remove, unlink, getenv.
